decision.thesis: No fundable name carries both a decomposed move and evidence that survives reading. IHH fell 3.04% on 2026-09-11 on the Tokyo court dismissing its subsidiary's YEN 200bn claim - a dateable cause, and negative, so a long-only book cannot act on it, and no market cap is collected to size the claim against. Petronas Chemicals is up 19.20% in five sessions on 3.2x median volume with zero indexable rows. Apple is the only name with a candidate story and one share is 33.2% of equity against a 25% cap. Cash.

settled: The collector outage carried as a billing diagnosis by the 2026-09-09, 09-10 and 09-11 pages is confirmed: the repository was made public on 2026-09-12, standard runners are unmetered on public repositories, and the collector ran the same day at 06:07Z and 12:54Z. paper-2026-09-11-allcash-21d-8bf9 will reach its 2026-10-11 grading date with marks behind it.
carried: fmp is 134h past a 78h cadence, having gone 110 -> 120 -> 134 across three readings; it is where price_target_consensus comes from for the three Nasdaq names.
conditions_for_a_position: MET, no effect: the collector has a runner again.
OPEN: Petronas Chemicals collects something a person wrote - 0 indexable rows on 2026-09-11, and 0 ever from nst_business (95 rows) or fmt_business (216 rows).
OPEN: the Bursa proxy prints a close so a Malaysian name can be decomposed - MYX:0820EA blank for 2026-09-11 on 500 shares traded.
NEW for Monday: whether IHH's own statement, published after Friday's close, moves the name on the next session, and whether a Bursa announcement puts a figure on the claim.
lessons: A condition can be met and change nothing; the collector was the visible constraint, not the binding one.
An event that can be dated precisely and cannot be sized is not tradeable.
Price and evidence can diverge for a week without either being wrong; the response to a 19% move with no coverage is to widen the search, not the position.
